feature: Ledger group selection and posting-role masters

studyReference.limitations: The saved screen capture shows 34 distinct labels. Full catalog positions, alias equivalence, hierarchy and custom group creation are not verified. Capture predates this batch and was not collected through REA.

rules.verifiedPostingRoles: Only the verified posting roles can currently be used by voucher posting. Other visible labels save as non-posting or general ledger masters.
rules.hierarchyAndNatures: Full group hierarchy (parent groups) and 4 financial natures (Assets, Liabilities, Expenses, Income) mapped across all 28 canonical groups and 34 display labels.
rules.openingBalances: Opening balances supported for all Balance Sheet groups (Assets and Liabilities natures) using whole paise.
rules.ledgerDeletion: Alt+D on custom ledger alteration deletes the master, opening balances and associated rows, with transaction presence protection and built-in Cash protection.
